s: Which is the largest animal that has ever lived?
fakta: A blue whale's heart is about the size of a small car.

s: Which bird is a symbol of wisdom in stories?
fakta: An owl cannot move its eyes, so it turns its whole head instead.

s: Which bird is on many British Christmas cards?
fakta: Robins sing all through the winter, even at night under street lamps.

s: What do tadpoles grow into?
fakta: A frog's tadpoles lose their tails as their legs grow.

s: What is a baby fox called?
fakta: Fox cubs are born blind in an underground den called an earth.

s: What is the fastest land animal?
fakta: A cheetah can reach about 110 km/h in short bursts.

s: How many legs does a spider have?
fakta: Most spiders also have eight eyes.

s: How many legs does an insect have?
fakta: An insect's body has three parts: head, thorax and abdomen.

s: What do bees collect from flowers to make honey?
fakta: Twelve bees together make only about one teaspoon of honey in their whole lives.

s: Which animal is known as the king of the jungle, though it lives on the savannah?
fakta: A lion's roar can be heard up to 8 km away.

s: What is the tallest animal in the world?
fakta: A giraffe has the same number of neck bones as a human: seven.

s: What do caterpillars turn into?
fakta: Inside its chrysalis, a caterpillar almost completely dissolves and rebuilds itself.

s: Which mammal can fly?
fakta: Flying squirrels only glide; bats really fly.

s: What do we call animals that eat only plants?
fakta: Cows, rabbits and elephants are herbivores.

s: Which sea creature has eight arms?
fakta: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood.

s: Which animal carries its home on its back?
fakta: Garden snails can live for several years.

s: What is the largest bird in the world?
fakta: An ostrich egg weighs about as much as 20 hen's eggs.

s: In which season do many trees lose their leaves?
fakta: Trees pull useful nutrients back from the leaves before they fall.

s: Which British animal rolls into a prickly ball when scared?
fakta: A hedgehog has about 5,000 to 7,000 spines.

s: What do squirrels hide in autumn to eat later?
fakta: Squirrels forget some of their nuts, and new trees grow from them.

s: Which black-and-white bear eats bamboo?
fakta: A panda can spend up to 14 hours a day eating.

s: Where does a polar bear live?
fakta: Under its white fur, a polar bear's skin is black.

s: Which animal is famous for building dams?
fakta: Beavers have been brought back to some rivers in Britain.

s: What makes flamingos pink?
fakta: Flamingos get their colour from pigments in the shrimps and algae they eat.

s: What are baby kangaroos called?
fakta: A newborn joey is only about the size of a jelly bean.

s: What is a group of crows called?
fakta: A group of lions is a pride and a group of geese a gaggle.

s: What is the national bird of Britain chosen in a 2015 public vote?
fakta: The robin won with about a third of the votes.

s: Which is the smallest British bird?
fakta: A goldcrest weighs about as much as a 20p coin.

s: How many hearts does an octopus have?
fakta: Two hearts pump blood through the gills and one through the body.

s: What do we call an animal that is active at night?
fakta: Owls, badgers, foxes and hedgehogs are nocturnal.

s: Which animal sleeps through the winter in Britain?
fakta: Hedgehogs hibernate from about November to March.

s: What is a female deer called?
fakta: A male deer is called a stag or a buck.

s: Which tree produces acorns?
fakta: A large oak can produce tens of thousands of acorns in a good year.

s: What is the largest land carnivore?
fakta: A big male polar bear can weigh over 700 kg.

s: What do whales breathe?
fakta: Whales breathe through a blowhole on top of their head.

s: What type of animal is a slow-worm?
fakta: Slow-worms are legless lizards that can blink, unlike snakes.

s: Which British bird of prey is the fastest animal in a dive?
fakta: A diving peregrine can reach over 300 km/h.

s: Which animal is the only mammal that lays eggs, together with the echidna?
fakta: The platypus has a bill like a duck, and the male has a venomous spur on its back legs.

s: What is a baby swan called?
fakta: Swans can live for over 20 years.

s: Which insect makes a sound by rubbing its legs against its wings?
fakta: Crickets and grasshoppers both chirp, but crickets rub their wings together.

s: What is the main food of a koala?
fakta: Koalas sleep up to 20 hours a day.

s: Which animal has the longest pregnancy?
fakta: An African elephant is pregnant for about 22 months.

s: What do bats use to find their way in the dark?
fakta: Bats send out high squeaks and listen for the echoes.

s: Which animal is the largest fish in the sea?
fakta: The whale shark eats tiny plankton and is harmless to people.

s: Which British seabird is nicknamed the ‘clown of the sea’?
fakta: A puffin can carry more than ten small fish in its beak at once.

s: Which tree is the national tree of England?
fakta: Many old pubs are called the Royal Oak after Charles II hid in an oak tree.

s: What kind of creature is a natterjack?
fakta: Natterjacks run instead of hopping and live on sand dunes.

s: Which animal changes colour to blend in?
fakta: Chameleons can also move their eyes in two directions at once.

s: How many arms does a common starfish have?
fakta: A starfish can grow back an arm it has lost.

s: What is a male bee called?
fakta: Drones do not have a sting.

s: Which tree has seeds that spin down like helicopters?
fakta: Children call the winged seeds ‘helicopters’.

s: Which British tree gives conkers?
fakta: The World Conker Championships are held in Northamptonshire.

s: What do caterpillars of the cabbage white butterfly eat?
fakta: Gardeners cover their cabbages with nets to keep the butterflies off.

s: Which animal has black and white stripes and lives in Africa?
fakta: No two zebras have exactly the same stripes.

s: What is the main food of a hedgehog?
fakta: Bread and milk are bad for hedgehogs.

s: What is the largest native land mammal in Britain?
fakta: A red deer stag can stand over 1.2 metres tall at the shoulder.

s: What is a group of owls called?
fakta: A charm is a group of goldfinches.

s: How long can a Greenland shark live?
fakta: It is the longest-living vertebrate known to science.

s: Which bird lays its eggs in other birds' nests?
fakta: The cuckoo chick pushes the other eggs out of the nest.

s: How many stomach chambers does a cow have?
fakta: A cow chews its food twice: once when eating and again as cud.

s: What is the only bird that can fly backwards?
fakta: A hummingbird's heart can beat over 1,000 times a minute.

s: Which British mammal is protected by its own law from 1992?
fakta: The Protection of Badgers Act was passed in 1992.

s: What colour is the blood of a horseshoe crab?
fakta: Its blood is used to test medicines for germs.

s: Which animal has the most powerful bite of any living creature?
fakta: A saltwater crocodile's bite is several times stronger than a lion's.

s: Which squirrel is native to Britain?
fakta: Grey squirrels were brought over from North America in the 1800s.

s: Which plant has the largest single flower in the world?
fakta: Rafflesia flowers can be a metre across and smell of rotting meat.

s: Which mammal has the thickest fur?
fakta: A sea otter has up to a million hairs per square inch.

s: What is the oldest kind of tree in Britain, some living for thousands of years?
fakta: The Fortingall Yew in Perthshire is thought to be at least 2,000 years old.

s: Which bird migrates furthest each year?
fakta: An Arctic tern flies from the Arctic to the Antarctic and back every year.

s: What does a dendrologist study?
fakta: The word comes from the Greek ‘dendron’, meaning tree.

s: Which creature has the largest eyes in the animal kingdom?
fakta: A giant squid's eye can be as big as a dinner plate.

s: Which is the only venomous snake in Britain?
fakta: Adders are shy, and their bite is rarely serious for people.

s: How many species of snake are native to Britain?
fakta: They are the adder, the grass snake and the smooth snake.

s: What is a baby hedgehog called?
fakta: Hoglets are born with soft spines under their skin.

s: Which plant family includes bamboo?
fakta: Some bamboo can grow almost a metre in a single day.

s: What is the name of the female fox?
fakta: A male fox is called a dog fox.

s: Which of these birds cannot fly?
fakta: The kiwi lays one of the largest eggs for its body size of any bird.
